title: CIA compartment so restricted nothing was recorded
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of CIA compartment so restricted nothing was recorded, about unspecified (CIA career) at CIA, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior officer at the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, says that during his career he was part of looking at one very specific matter that was kept so tightly sealed that nothing about it was put into any kind of record. He calls this highly unusual and irregular, even for the CIA. If true, it would mean some subjects were hidden even from the agency's own files.
